headline: 77,799 vacancies: New circular coming soon to hire teachers in institutions
summary: The government is preparing a new recruitment notice to fill nearly 78,000 vacant teacher positions across educational institutions.
details: The government will soon issue a new circular to fill 77,799 vacant teacher positions in educational institutions across the country.
This move aims to address the critical shortage of educators and improve the quality of teaching in schools and colleges.
The recruitment process will be streamlined to ensure qualified candidates are appointed to these roles quickly.
The announcement comes as part of a broader effort to strengthen the national education system and ensure students have access to adequate instructional support.

headline: Budget support boosts Bangladesh's foreign exchange reserves
summary: The country's reserves have seen an increase following the receipt of budget support funds.
details: Bangladesh's foreign exchange reserves have increased due to the arrival of budget support funds.
The boost in reserves is attributed to the latest disbursement of financial assistance intended for national budget support.
Foreign exchange reserves are critical for managing imports and ensuring economic stability in the face of global market fluctuations.
The Bangladesh Bank is monitoring the situation to maintain a steady flow of foreign currency into the country.
